_comment: GLB-swap protocol: replace the asset under public/models/brain/, run npm run validate:brain-model to confirm the node names, then update the bindings below. Code does not need to change.

parts.label: Posterior left cortex
parts.note: Visible posterior cortical chunk mapped to visual processing.

parts.label: Superior left cortex
parts.note: Broad superior region; thalamus is assigned here because the source GLB has no named internal thalamic mesh.

parts.label: Anterior left cortex
parts.note: Anterior cortical surface mapped to planning and executive function.

parts.label: Lateral temporal cortex
parts.note: Temporal-facing visible chunk; hippocampus is approximated to this region for v1.

parts.label: Inferior temporal base
parts.note: Inferior visible chunk used for hidden limbic/deep structures that are not separately named in the GLB.

parts.label: Posterior right cortex
parts.note: Posterior/inferior chunk used for cerebellar activity in the first working mode.

parts.label: Anterior right cortex
parts.note: Right-side visible cortical chunk shared by planning and integration signals.

parts.label: Central base
parts.note: Base chunk mapped to autonomic/cardiorespiratory signalling.
